AgentAttention.description: The agent's claude is waiting on a person; `state` is unchanged by it.
AgentAttention.title: AgentAttention

AgentBootstrapStep.description:
A wrapper bootstrap step. `message` is set on failure only: redacted by the wrapper and
truncated here.
AgentBootstrapStep.title: AgentBootstrapStep

AgentTokenIn.description: An agent token a service was handed by one of its sessions' agents, to be checked.
AgentTokenIn.title: AgentTokenIn

BackupRun.description: A finished transcripts save: when it finished and the archive size.
BackupRun.title: BackupRun

BootstrapFailure.description:
Why one agent's wrapper session failed to start: the step, a one-line message and the
redacted log tail (cut like check logs). `step` is "create" when the create itself failed.
BootstrapFailure.title: BootstrapFailure

CreateTerminal.description: Both sizes are optional; the wrapper validates the 1..1000 range (`invalid_size`).
CreateTerminal.title: CreateTerminal

DialogAnswer.description: A person's answer to the open dialog; forwarded to the wrapper unchanged.
DialogAnswer.title: DialogAnswer

DialogPermissionView.description: A held PermissionRequest of the agent's claude (wrapper 0.11.0).
DialogPermissionView.title: DialogPermissionView

DialogView.description: What the agent's claude waits on: the wrapper's dialog state plus the agent identity.
DialogView.title: DialogView

EnvVar-Input.description:
One session env variable, GitLab CI style: `{value, expand}`, or a vault reference.

A plain variable carries its value; `expand` gates `$` handling of it. A vault reference
`{vault, env}` names an agents-vault entry and its env; the entry's value is resolved by the
vault at session create. A reference carries nothing else.
EnvVar-Input.title: EnvVar

FileStamp.description: The `mtime` and `size` of a file as the content route (or the last save) reported them.
FileStamp.title: FileStamp

InactivityLimits.description:
Per-preset inactivity limits, in seconds, overriding `ORCH_INACTIVITY_REMINDER_SECONDS` and
`ORCH_INACTIVITY_CLOSE_SECONDS`: unset uses the setting, 0 turns the limit off.
InactivityLimits.title: InactivityLimits

applies.default: when your turn has ended and your background agents have reported
applies.title: Applies

PresetPatch.description:
Admin partial edit: `spec` is an RFC 7396 merge patch of the stored spec. A `project`
other than the stored one moves the preset.
PresetPatch.title: PresetPatch

ProposalIn.description:
A change proposal (plan 3.4): an RFC 7396 merge `patch` of the target's spec, which
may carry vault references (never a value).
ProposalIn.title: ProposalIn

ProposalRevise.description: A new revision: a full proposal against the target as it is now, not a delta.
ProposalRevise.title: ProposalRevise

ReviewIn.description: A human review of the proposal's current revision: one decision per item (plan 3.4).
ReviewIn.title: ReviewIn

SessionBackup.description:
What a discard would save now; each flag is true only when that save would really run.

`reason` is null when both run, else `no_session_cache` (no `spec.cache`),
`cache_not_configured` (no S3 cache configured) or the save's skip reason, the workdir's first.
SessionBackup.title: SessionBackup

SessionSpecPatch.description: Agent edit of a live session: `spec` is an RFC 7396 merge patch of the stored spec.
SessionSpecPatch.title: SessionSpecPatch

SweepPolicyIn.description: The whole sweep policy; every field is required (a PUT replaces the saved policy).
SweepPolicyIn.title: SweepPolicyIn

UsageQuota.description:
Per-preset ceilings, in percent of the account's usage windows, below the default
(`ORCH_USAGE_QUOTA_DEFAULT`) at which starting or growing a session is refused. A metric
left unset uses the default.
UsageQuota.title: UsageQuota

UsageView.description: The account's usage windows as the usage gate reads them (read-only).
UsageView.title: UsageView

VaultAttachIn.description:
Attach a vault entry to a preset: `envs` maps entry env to preset env (every env of the
entry under its own name when omitted); `replace` lets it overwrite an existing preset env.
VaultAttachIn.title: VaultAttachIn

VaultAttachView.description:
The preset view an admin vault attach answers. `attachment_privileged` marks a preset
whose session can read every Secret in the namespace (`privileged` is not empty); marked,
never blocked.
VaultAttachView.title: VaultAttachView

VaultPinView.description: What a session was pinned to for one vault env variable; never a value.
VaultPinView.title: VaultPinView

WorkspaceCache.description:
`restore_key` and `save_key` are Jinja templates (surface `archive_name`).

None is unset: a preset-derived session gets `default_cache_key` for both when both are None.
An empty string is explicit: empty `restore_key` is a fresh start, empty `save_key` is
restore-only. A restore_key ending in `/` restores the newest archive under that prefix.
WorkspaceCache.title: WorkspaceCache

WrapperSettings.description: Typed claude-code-wrapper settings a session may carry (create-time only).
WrapperSettings.title: WrapperSettings

WriteFile.description:
Body of a file save: both keys required; `expected: null` overwrites unconditionally.

A body over 6 MiB + 16 KiB (1 MiB of content, every byte escaped) is 413 `too_large`
before it is read in full.
WriteFile.title: WriteFile

get.description:
The digest of the newest stored tool calls, results and finished turns of the caller's
session, own lines included. `agent` keeps one pod's lines; a name that matches nothing
gives an empty list, since gone agents' lines are history.
get.summary: Recent activity lines of the caller's session, oldest first (read-only)

post.description: Confirm or reject a room request from the answer to its attached decision.

409.description: not_pending, or decision_open (the user has not answered yet)

schema.title: Response List Presets Agent V1 Admin Presets Get

delete.description:
Remove every ref to the entry from a manageable preset, or only the one under preset env
`?env=`; 404 `not_attached` when nothing matches.

put.description:
Attach a vault entry as refs, in one save, on a manageable preset (privileged ones too).
`envs` maps entry env to preset env; one entry env may back several preset envs through
repeated calls, which keep the refs already there. Without `envs` every env of the entry is
attached under its own name. A preset env that is taken is 409 `env_exists` unless
`replace`. The answer marks `attachment_privileged` (marked, never blocked).

get.description: A superleader reads its own or a manageable session; any other leader its own.

patch.description:
RFC 7396 merge patch of a live session's spec: a superleader on its own or a manageable
session, any other leader on its own. The source preset is never written.

post.description: Restart one agent by pod name; an agent of the caller's own session is a self-restart.

Withdraw a pending handover request (`request_id`), or every one of the session when it
is omitted: the session's own leader, or a superleader on its own or a manageable session.
A withdrawn request is rejected with reason `withdrawn` and never applied. The reconciler's
`rollout` request is never withdrawn (409 `rollout_request` by id, left queued without).

Restart every live agent of a session. The caller's own session claims the self-restart
cooldown and gets one note, all in the same transaction as the commands.

get.description:
The account's five_hour and seven_day windows, read-only, from the same cached
`UsageSource` the usage gate reads. An unconfigured or unreachable usage service answers
200 with `available` false and null windows: the gate allows then, and so does this.
The vault entries in the caller's project scope and the env names to re-attach.

502.description: Wrapper unreachable or answered an unexpected body

post.description:
Allow, deny or dismiss the open dialog; the wrapper's 4xx (409 `no_dialog`,
`dialog_changed`, `permission_resolved`, `not_dismissable`) pass through. The log line
carries no message text and no tool input. The main port has no user identity (the
source allowlist is the auth), so the caller is the peer address. The origin guard runs
inside the audited block so refused answers (403, 404, 409) are logged too.

409.description: Agent not ready, or the wrapper's no_dialog, dialog_changed, permission_resolved or not_dismissable

502.description: Wrapper unreachable or answered an unexpected body

exact match. The filters combine.

delete.description:
Discard the session. On the service port a service may discard only a session it created
itself; any other session answers 404 `not_found`, like an unknown one. `?force=true` (main
port only) abandons the owed pre-discard hooks, also of a session already deleting.

The wrapper's status is mapped before any byte is sent, so every refusal is a JSON error.

Move a live session to another project. Scope is read live per request, so the move
takes effect at once. A move is a new placement: the target must exist and be active (422
`unknown_project`, `project_archived`); its row is locked before the session row.
